reason: A user-interface theme plugin for DeepSeek Harness that adds four Catppuccin themes, configurable glassmorphism styling, persistent appearance preferences, and an npm update check.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供 Latte、Frappé、Macchiato 和 Mocha 四种 Catppuccin 主题及可调节的玻璃拟态界面效果。
summaries.en: Adds four Catppuccin themes and configurable glassmorphism styling to the DeepSeek Harness interface.

capabilities: Applies Catppuccin color themes to the DeepSeek Harness interface
Persists theme and appearance preferences locally
Queries the npm registry to check for plugin updates
